The agencies shall furnish last three years work order. For similar works in various govt. department/ boards/corporation. (Order copy of various Departments /Boards and corporation for the respective years (2022-23 2023-24 & 2024-25) the has to submit the following details
The agency should have registered with GST
The agency must have valid PAN card

GST returns for the last three financial years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
